rationale: Abstract from ϫⲱⲡ/ⲭⲱⲡ 'be hidden.' Paired with ⲙⲛⲧⲁϣⲓⲡⲉ 'shame' as the two negative conditions afflicting the Mind of Light in its embodiment. ⲙⲛⲧ- prefix forms abstract noun: 'state of being hidden.'

Compound: ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ (Lyc. = ⲣⲟⲉⲓⲥ 'watch, keep guard') = 'place of watching, watch-post.' The body is described as having watch-posts (sense-faculties as guards) which are missing or have failed.

Likely orthographic variant of παρεμβολή 'military encampment, array' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲏ). The body 'falls at the feet of his array' — the Mind of Light's marshalled order which the body defies.
Lyc. qualitative of ϩⲱⲧⲙ 'shut up, be closed.' Used here of the reflections of the body sealed off from sin.

Possibly Lyc. nomen actionis from ⲥⲱⲕ 'draw, drag.' The 'pulls/snares of Sin' from which the reflections are shut off. Could alternatively be related to ⲛⲕⲟⲧⲕ̄ 'sleep' (sleep of Sin). Etymology uncertain.
Compound ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who') + ⲓ̈ⲱⲣⲍ (Lyc. = ⲱⲣϩ̄/ⲱⲣⲥ̄ 'watch, behold'). Standard agentive parallel to ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' Used here of one who has the seeing eye.
Plural ⲛ̄ⲣⲉⲓ̈ⲧⲉ paired with ⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ 'kinds.' Possibly Lyc. for ⲣⲏⲧⲉ 'manner, form, kind.' The bodily forms/types alongside the Greek ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ in describing what worldly conquerors employ.
Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ 'he said' — past tense speech-introducer (cf. accumulated ⲡⲧⲁⲭⲉ same root). Standard Kephalaia narrative formula.
Lycopolitan reflex of Sahidic ϩⲓⲧⲛ̄ 'through, by means of.' Standard preposition. Here in idiom +ⲍⲧⲏⲕ ⲍⲓⲧⲛ ⲡⲉⲓ̈ 'pay attention through this' = 'attend to this matter.'
Editor's tentative restoration in metals sequence (gold, silver, X, bronze). May represent iron, tin, or another metal. Marked as uncertain by the editor with (?).
Abstract ⲙⲛⲧ- + ⲗⲉⲙⲏϣⲉ. The element ⲗⲉⲙⲏϣⲉ may be related to Sah. ⲣⲉⲙⲙⲏϣⲉ 'multitude-person' or to ⲙⲏϣⲉ 'multitude' with assimilation. Mani's 'multitude' = his church-community.
